title: SQL injection vulnerability: the `username` request parameter is concatenated directly into the SQL query string on line
description: SQL injection vulnerability: the `username` request parameter is concatenated directly into the SQL query string on line 40 without sanitization or parameterization. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g., `' OR '1'='1' --`) to dump or modify data. Use a PreparedStatement with parameterized queries instead.
